requirements.quote:
From the
   perspective of QUIC, HelloRetryRequest is not differentiated from
   other cryptographic handshake messages that are carried in Initial
   packets.
requirements.condition: When QUIC carries a TLS HelloRetryRequest message.
requirements.required_behavior: Carry the HelloRetryRequest as cryptographic handshake data in Initial packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not carry HelloRetryRequest using a packet type reserved for a later encryption level.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet trace can locate the HelloRetryRequest bytes and verify that their CRYPTO data is carried in Initial packets.

requirements.quote:
From the
   perspective of QUIC, HelloRetryRequest is not differentiated from
   other cryptographic handshake messages that are carried in Initial
   packets.
requirements.condition: When QUIC processes or transmits a HelloRetryRequest in Initial packets.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply the same QUIC-layer handling used for other cryptographic handshake messages in Initial packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not assign HelloRetryRequest distinct QUIC-layer framing or packet semantics merely because of its TLS message type.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation and packet traces can compare HelloRetryRequest framing, encryption level, and packet handling with other Initial-level handshake messages.

requirements.quote:
Although it is in principle possible to use this feature
   for address verification, QUIC implementations SHOULD instead use the
   Retry feature; see Section 8.1 of [QUIC-TRANSPORT].
requirements.condition: When a QUIC implementation performs client address verification.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the QUIC Retry feature for address verification.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Avoid using TLS HelloRetryRequest as the address-verification mechanism.
requirements.why_checkable: An address-verification test can observe whether the endpoint sends a QUIC Retry packet or a TLS HelloRetryRequest for that purpose.
